menu_options.cloud_qr: Automatic (scan QR with Smart Life / Tuya Smart app)

manual.title: Manual entry
manual.description: Paste the Device ID and Local Key you retrieved from iot.tuya.com (Cloud Development Project → Devices).

cloud_qr.title: Link your Smart Life / Tuya Smart account
cloud_qr.description: Enter your app's user code (Profile → Settings → Account and Security → user code in the Smart Life / Tuya Smart app — not your email or password).

scan.title: Scan this QR code
scan.description: Open the Smart Life / Tuya Smart app and scan this code, confirm on your phone, then press Submit here.

pick_device.title: Select your pump
pick_device.description: Pick the device from your linked account, and provide/override its local IP if it wasn't reported automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the pump locally with these credentials. Check the IP address and that the pump is on the same subnet.
error.login_error: Tuya login failed — check the user code, or the QR code may have expired.
error.ip_required: No IP was reported for this device — enter it manually.

abort.device_list_failed: Could not list devices from your Tuya account after login.
abort.no_devices_found: No device with a usable local key was found on this account.
